Confirmed: our orchestration supports both the stabilization window and the backoff policy. Notes below for the amendment and the runbook we'll share in the Jan 8 walkthrough: 

- Stabilization window: configurable (default 60s). During this window we keep a small fraction (~10%) of traffic on existing replicas while the new instances populate KV caches and steady-state metrics are observed.
- Backoff policy: 3 consecutive scale-up failures -> automatic failover to hosted variant + Pager duty alert. We record all failovers in audit logs (link in Drive).
- Telemetry: token-level latency and per-replica warm-start metrics will be surfaced in the Console and exported to your S3 if you enable retention.

I've updated the term amendment to incorporate the stabilization window and the failover credits clause (see Evera_Term_Amendment_v2.pdf). Also attached: throughput-test-results.csv (synthetic ramp that shows 95th % scale-up times at ~38s for the requested configuration).
